cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And now we've learned not to need one contract.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.

mechanism: A approves business losses as required lessons and uses managerial authority to prescribe the next loss.
confusable: Unlike simple optimism, rejection itself is declared necessary education rather than a temporary obstacle.
comparison: Business solvency and equipment loss differ from the reciprocal personal possession loss in b.
